note: Owner direction: train mostly on Ukrainian, cowboy/Western and American Indian imagery. Weights are sampling shares for training and blend defaults; other traditions stay in the corpus for diversity and the distance check.

rules.Native American (structure only): Symmetry, rhythm, density and banding statistics only. No motifs, no tribal names in designs or marketing, never presented as Native-made (Indian Arts and Crafts Act). Sacred, ceremonial and funerary objects are excluded by the corpus gate.
